observed_original_abi.calling_convention: thiscall; receiver in ECX (MOV ESI,ECX at 0x0095fd64)
observed_original_abi.receiver: ECX, saved to ESI at 0x0095fd64, used as the base for [ESI+0xa8], [ESI+0x1dc] and both vtable loads
observed_original_abi.argument_surface: one ordinary stack dword, read once at 0x0095fd6c as [ESP+0x24] (frame base + 0x24 after SUB ESP,0x1c / PUSH ESI), popped by the callee via RET 0x4 at 0x0095fdb4
observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: MODELLED AS void AND BACKED BY THE DISASSEMBLY: no EAX write participates in any result path - the only EAX writes are loads of [ESI+0xa8] and of the two vtable slot words used as CALL targets, and the single exit 0x0095fdb0..0x0095fdb4 is POP ESI / ADD ESP,0x1c / RET 0x4 with no value materialised. Ghidra independently projects 'void UTFWin__Window__func35(IWindow *this,int param_2)'. Confidence high; the caveat is only that a __thiscall void member function may leave a stale EAX, which no caller can observe here because all 32 references to 0x0095fd60 are DATA vtable entries, not CALL sites.
observed_original_abi.locals: 28-byte frame (SUB ESP,0x1c) plus PUSH ESI; a 0x14-byte record is built at frame base + 0x04 and only its words at +0x08, +0x0c and +0x10 are stored
observed_original_abi.outgoing_call_0x114: PUSH of &record at 0x0095fd8e, ECX = receiver, CALL EDX at 0x0095fd99 with no caller stack adjustment afterwards, so the callee pops that argument (callee cleanup on the slot 0x114 target)

observed_mechanics: 0x0095fd60 SUB ESP,0x1c / 0x0095fd63 PUSH ESI / 0x0095fd64 MOV ESI,ECX: 28-byte frame plus callee-saved ESI holding the receiver.
0x0095fd66 MOV EAX,[ESI+0xa8] reads the receiver word at offset 0xa8 into EAX; 0x0095fd6c MOV ECX,[ESP+0x24] reads the incoming stack argument.

0x0095fd70 CMP ECX,EAX / 0x0095fd72 JZ 0x0095fdb0: when the argument equals the word already at +0xa8 the body is skipped entirely and the function falls straight to POP ESI / ADD ESP,0x1c / RET 0x4 - no field store, no virtual call.
0x0095fd74 MOV [ESI+0xa8],ECX: the new value is committed to offset 0xa8 BEFORE any dispatch, so the field is already updated when the slot 0x114 callee runs.

0x0095fd7a MOV [ESP+0x10],ECX and 0x0095fd7e MOV [ESP+0x14],EAX write the new and previous words into the outgoing record at frame base + 0x14 and + 0x18; 0x0095fd91 MOV [ESP+0x10],0x13 (after the PUSH at 0x0095fd8e, i.e. frame base + 0x0c) writes the constant 0x13 into the record word at record + 0x08.

0x0095fd82 MOV EAX,[ESI] / 0x0095fd84 MOV EDX,[EAX+0x114] / 0x0095fd8a LEA ECX,[ESP+0x4] / 0x0095fd8e PUSH ECX / 0x0095fd8f MOV ECX,ESI / 0x0095fd99 CALL EDX: one register-indirect thiscall into vtable slot 0x114 with &record (frame base + 0x04) as the single stack argument; the callee pops it.

0x0095fd9b CMP dword ptr [ESI+0x1dc],0x0 / 0x0095fda2 JZ 0x0095fdb0: the receiver word at offset 0x1dc is a pure zero/non-zero gate on the second dispatch; the machine never inspects the value beyond the comparison with zero.

0x0095fda4 MOV EAX,[ESI] / 0x0095fda6 MOV EDX,[EAX+0x90] / 0x0095fdac MOV ECX,ESI / 0x0095fdae CALL EDX: the gated second dispatch is a thiscall into vtable slot 0x90 with no stack argument, always after the slot 0x114 call.
0x0095fdb0 POP ESI / 0x0095fdb1 ADD ESP,0x1c / 0x0095fdb4 RET 0x4: single shared exit; RET 0x4 proves caller cleanup of the one 4-byte argument.

All 32 references to 0x0095fd60 are DATA pointers into vtable images, every one at vtable_base + 0x04, and the word at vtable_base + 0x00 is 0x0095fa30 (SDK label UTFWin::Window::IsAncestorOf). The function is therefore a virtual reached only through vtable slot +0x04 and shared unchanged by 32 Window-derived vtable images; there is no direct CALL or JMP immediate to it anywhere in the image.

Record words +0x00 and +0x04 are never stored by this function; only +0x08, +0x0c and +0x10 are written, so the callee at slot 0x114 observes the first eight bytes as whatever the frame happened to contain.

Codegen correspondence check (g++ 12 -m32 -O2 on the staging .cpp): the compiler emits the same compare-and-branch-over early-out, the same pre-dispatch store to [ECX+0xa8], the same 0x13 constant into record +0x08 with the record address pushed, CALL DWORD PTR [EAX+0x114], the zero test on [ECX+0x1dc] with the jne to CALL DWORD PTR [EAX+0x90], and the same RET 0x4 caller cleanup. The only additions are the -fstack-protector canary and the explicit zeroing of record +0x00/+0x04, which the original leaves indeterminate.

called_slot_0x90.notes: 0x013fdb6c and 0x01414c14 both hold 0x00960280; the vtable images at 0x01414ed4/0x0141873c/0x014190d4/0x0141930c/0x014195ac hold 0x00961950. FUN_00960280 walks this->0x3c as a cursor until this->0x38, mapping that word (0 or 8 -> 0, otherwise value-4) into a call through vtable slot 0xe0, i.e. a pending-event drain. The slot return value is discarded by func35.

called_slot_0x114.notes: 0x013fdb6c holds 0x00993200 (no Ghidra function defined at that address); 0x01414c14 holds 0x006f2f20, which decompiles to a bare 'return 0' stub. The record layout above is taken from the producer side only; the consumer's interpretation of code 0x13 is not established.

type_scope: package-local qualified names only; no global type record added

semantic_findings.finding: func35 is an idempotent state setter: it latches the argument at +0xa8, suppresses all work when the value is unchanged, and on a real transition emits a (0x13, new, previous) record through vtable slot 0x114 before optionally draining the pending queue through slot 0x90.
Two register-indirect calls, both with the receiver in ECX; slot 0x114 takes one callee-cleaned stack pointer, slot 0x90 takes none and its return value is discarded.
The +0xa8 store precedes both dispatches, and the slot 0x90 call can only follow a completed slot 0x114 call.

The function occupies vtable offset +0x04 in 32 Window-derived vtable images, directly after the slot +0x00 the SDK labels UTFWin::Window::IsAncestorOf (0x0095fa30), and is never overridden in the images scanned - the pointer is identical everywhere.

unresolved_questions: What the constant 0x13 in record +0x08 denotes: the SDK gives no name for func35, and the decompiler's 'Enum ObjectTYPE' warning is program-wide rather than tied to this literal, so no enum meaning is claimed.

Whether the word at +0xa8 and the argument are object pointers or plain identifiers: this function only compares, stores and forwards the word, so nothing here distinguishes a pointer from an id; the value is kept as an opaque 32-bit word.

What vtable slot 0x114 does with the record. Its two observed implementations are an address with no defined function (0x00993200) and a stub returning 0 (0x006f2f20), so the consumer-side meaning of (0x13, new, previous) is unresolved.

Whether the +0x1dc gate is a dirty/needs-invalidate flag. Only a zero test is observed here; the flag's producer and full field extent beyond 0x1df are unestablished (0x1e0 is only the arithmetic end of the last dword, not an observed object size).
The declaring class of func35 within UTFWin::Window: no MSVC RTTI exists in SporeApp.exe, so the owning class and its position in the hierarchy are not provable from this target alone.
